init-agents.description: Create or update AGENTS.md with full project context
init-agents.template:
Read all the source files in this project. Then, update the AGENTS.md file in the project's root directory if it already exists, or create it if it doesn't. The file should contain the following:
- The project's purpose and high-level description. What the project does.
- An overview of the project structure, the key files and their roles.
- How to run the project and its dependencies (runtime, package manager, environment variables, etc.).
- The coding conventions observed in the existing code.
- Known limitations or TODOs found in the code or comments.
Important: Language rules that apply to all future work in this project:
- You may communicate with me in Slovak when I write in Slovak.
- All code must be in English without exception: variable names, function names, class names, comments, docstrings, log messages, user-facing output, CLI prompts, error messages, everything.
- If you ever suggest a name or write any code, it must be in English regardless of what language we are discussing it in.
Important: Maintenance rules that apply to all future work in this project:
- The AGENTS.md file must be kept up to date.
- Before ending any session where you made changes to the project structure, modules, dependencies, or how the project is run — you must update the relevant sections of AGENTS.md. This is not optional.

lint.description: Run ruff linter and report issues
lint.template:
Run the ruff linter on the entire project using: uv tool run ruff check .
Report all findings with file paths and line numbers. If there are no issues, confirm the project is clean.

format-check.template:
Check code formatting using: uv tool run ruff format . --check
Report which files would be reformatted. If everything is already formatted correctly, confirm it.

run.template:
Run the main project script using: uv run sync_spotify.py
Wait for it to finish, then evaluate the output — check for errors, exceptions, or unexpected results. Summarize what happened and whether the run was successful.

Then repeat the same with the other project scripts using:
- uv run analyze_liked_songs.py
- uv run list_all_artists.py
Wait for it to finish, then evaluate the output — check for errors, exceptions, or unexpected results. Summarize what happened and whether the run was successful.

check-all.description: Full project check: lint + format + run
check-all.template:
Perform a full project check in this exact order:
1. Run linter: uv tool run ruff check .
2. Check formatting: uv tool run ruff format . --check
3. Run the main script: uv run sync_spotify.py

After each step report the result. If lint or format check fails, report the issues but continue to the next step. After all three steps provide a final summary of the overall project health.
